newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Sydkraft 1996 profit 2.45 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Sydkraft 1996 profit 2.45 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish power company Sydkraft AB's 1996 profit is expected to fall marginally to 2.45 billion crowns after financial items compared to 2.50 billion in 1995, a Reuter poll of eight analysts showed on Tuesday.
Forecasts ranged from 2.37 billion to 2.61 billion.
The company itself has said it expected a profit of 2.4 billion crowns after financial items for the year.
Sydkraft is expected to raise its dividend to four crowns per share from the 3.75 crowns it paid in 1995.
The company is due to publish its result on February 27.
Sources participating in this survey were Aros, Carnegie, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Morgan Stanley, Paribas, Swedbank, and Ohman.
